key_insight: Self-rewarded reinforcement learning improved the length and organization of Mistral-7B medical explanations without human preference labels.
engineering_relevance: PPO with LoRA offers a lightweight route to shaping explanation style in small models intended for on-premises clinical deployment.
method: Start with instruction-tuned Mistral-7B and 2,000 Meerkat-derived medical prompts.
Apply PPO with LoRA using rewards for length, lexical diversity, and punctuation, plus penalties for very short responses.
Train for about 170 PPO steps on one NVIDIA A100 GPU.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports rising average reward and quantitative and qualitative comparisons showing longer, more organized, multi-point explanations while preserving underlying medical content.
watch_item: Style-based rewards may favor verbosity without improving clinical correctness; the abstract does not establish clinical safety.
paper_title: Self-Rewarded Reinforcement Learning for Better-Structured Medical Explanations in Small Language Models
